kind: Offline, historical, outcome-blind recipe registration. No new future issues.
scope: Project senior men regular domestic first divisions with existing WCPP-ML-0.1 test artifacts. Cross-competition club fixtures enter as prior workload only. Domestic cups or continental tournaments as target, national teams, youth, reserves, women and friendlies do not enter this two-arm league comparison. Never infer an identity from a club name. Report missing competition and team coverage.
roster: Inspect retained prematch ordinary league fixtures/packets from October 12 through November 23, 2026 UTC with original target identity, cutoff and a contemporaneous team calendar or independently corroborated match archive. Use every scoped target in each selected entire source packet. Demarcate clocked source coverage vs selective last-six-only, and keep missingness. Reject same-fixture duplicate or changed actual kickoff. Exclude overlap with R7 first issues using IDs and ordered teams/time. Fully evaluated seen windows remain diagnostic. Select input sources and sign exact roster before reading/scoring target results.
split: Existing booster per competition trained and built before each target. No fitting, search, threshold or model selection on these targets. Earlier block through 2026-11-15 23:59:59Z, later block November 16–23 UTC. No retroactive first issue or independent prospective validation. Calendar sources, target identities or original fixture freezes can be assembled after the match only when the underlying prematch edition and clock are bound.
comparison: Exactly one change in the native WCPP-ML-0.1 LightGBM/DC mixture. Starting from the same pre-cutoff archived model artifact, fixture and non-gap features, set own/opponent same_cohort_gap to the most recent verified played domestic league game in control vs the most recent verified played competitive senior first-team club game in treatment. Respect native UTC calendar day difference capped at 21. Publish uncapped elapsed kickoff hours as a separate diagnostic; only report end-to-kickoff rest when the actual terminal whistle timestamp is evidenced. No assumed final-whistle/90-minute addition. Same weights, DC component, alpha, probabilities-to-decisions and complete fixture set. If a common schedule is unverified do not invent a rest correction. Report both complete paired calendar subset and demonstrable corrections. Both arms use the same data cutoff, and neither is recorded as historically presented.
calendar: For both arms validate original bytes and fetch time, stable event ID, ordered native team IDs, target competition/season/phase and UTC kickoff. Require prior senior official fixture completed as of the cutoff. Reject or flag ambiguous, abandoned, cancellation, unplayed, youth, friendly, reserve, unsupported edition, duplicate IDs/conflicting times, or unresolved intervening entries. A future calendar entry cannot prove a match already played. Keep the independent source capture date on every earlier match. A later repository restoration is not an earlier independent timestamp. Report date and evidence coverage.
grading: Lock both matrices before outcome access. Only verifiable regulation-time settled scores. Use research_program.three_arm_model score_picks/top_three_scores, WDL highest probability, real common observed two-sided totals with actual quarter line; record full/half wins, pushes, half/full losses, with push removed from strict hit-rate denominator. Report paired changes gained/lost and full score log loss. Keep feeds, raw quoted times vs receipt times and absent eligible lines explicit. User-displayed score triple, user primary and top-three fixtures have no candidate delivery in this historical replay. Do not give these a percentage. Date clustering conditional on enough independent dates for interpretation.
decision: For consideration only: positive later matrix Top1 gain with no deterioration in Top3, WDL or score log loss, useful coverage and uncertainty. If absent or very sparse, stop this fixed substitution; no promotion/reweighting or added parallel forward arm.
